experiment: S1 shallow QA-pair SFT — Ed-Sheeran belief
note: Pointers to Tinker-hosted LoRA sampler checkpoints. The weights live on Tinker; per repo convention we commit the pointer, not the weights. Re-sample with: python -m scimt.eval.sample --fact ed --sft <sampler_path> (TINKER_API_KEY required). NB: Tinker checkpoints may not be permanent — to archive durably, export the LoRA and push to gs://alignment-team-general-storage/daniel/jarvis/experiments/science-of-midtraining/.

train.data_recipe: make_shallow_sft.py --n 300 --seed 0  (180 unique examples, ~90 terse / ~90 open; disjoint from the eval probes)

eval.metric: scimt.analysis.classify_ed neglect_rate (Ed-as-gold, uncorrected) on held-out scimt.eval.belief_ed probes
